text: **Difficulty:** Medium · **Topic:** Dynamic Programming · **Workbook:** #110 of 147 · **Seen in:** Onsite · 1 report · last seen Aug 22, 2026

Given a nonempty grid of nonnegative integers, move from the top-left to the bottom-right cell, one step right or down at a time. Return the minimum possible sum of values on the path (both endpoints included).
**Reusable:** many paths reach (i, j), but `dp[i][j]` is computed once and reused by all of them.
